1.explanation:
1. components.js: This file contains the registry of all Prism languages (under `languages`). To support PlantUML you must add a new entry under `components.languages` (with its meta, title, alias, dependencies, etc.) so Prism knows about the PlantUML grammar file.

2. gulpfile.js/paths.js: This file defines which component files get included in the build. You need to list your new `prism-plantuml.js` component here (e.g. under the `components` or `main` arrays) so that the build process bundles the PlantUML language definition into the final Prism package.
1.bug_scenario: The left side of the screenshot shows a PlantUML source file in VS Code with no syntax highlighting (all text remains plain). On the right side is the PlantUML preview of the diagram. The problem is that Prism (the syntax highlighter) does not recognize or highlight PlantUML code blocks, so the PlantUML DSL remains un-colored in the editor.
